name: Henge experimental (Tomba247)
subtitle: Unofficial Henge builds for testing
description: Test builds of Henge, macOS on iPhone and iPad, from github.com/Tomba247/Henge (a fork of Leviidev/Henge, GPL-2.0-or-later). Each build says which branch it came from. Henge needs JIT (StikJIT or StikDebug) and the increased-memory and extended-addressing entitlements, so sign it with a development certificate.

apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on your iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad: a virtual machine with its own arm64 translator, emulated devices and Metal graphics. These are unofficial test builds; the branch name is at the start of each version's notes. Upstream: github.com/Leviidev/Henge.

versions.localizedDescription: [league-el0] SCTLR_EL1 writes at EL1 inline when M, WXN, E0E and EE stay as they are (xnu writes it on every kernel entry and exit of a process with other PAC keys: 586K a second with League running)
[league-el0] Merge upstream PR #155: the control pill tucks into a handle at the top when there is no room beside the Mac
[league-el0] Microphone: half a second kept when the Mac is late for a buffer (a tenth cut the sound: clicks, static); gaps counted; the first 15 s saved to Documents/mic-capture.raw
[league-el0] Trackpad: a held still press then moved drags (as Moonlight's trackpad mode); held still and lifted, it right-clicks
[league-el0] The refresh time at +68 of the display page, where AppleParavirtDisplay reads it (found in macOS 15.6.1's kernelcache)
[league-el0] Experimental: the refresh event's time on the Mac's clock at +108 of the display page (HV_PVG_VSYNC_TS)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory off by default (on the phone it made the Mac 5-10x slower: 60% of the time in page faults)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory tries smaller windows when 16 GB a CPU does not fit (the phone refused the fourth)
[league-el0] Experimental: direct app memory (upstream #157 prototype), boot crash fixed

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Henge uses the local network to pair with this iPhone for JIT, without a computer.
